subject: Founders Edge — startup credit qualification & milestone plan
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@foundersedge.xyz>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: LaunchLab Partnerships <partnerships@launchlab.co>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Founders Edge accelerator — request for starter credits and milestone plan

Hi Kimberly / Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Founders Edge is excited about Redwood’s latency profile for our cohort workloads. We’d like to formally request a starter credit allocation for our upcoming Fall cohort (10 companies). High level ask: 150k generation tokens + 20k embedding units, with an optional 1-month trial extension for companies that pass the first milestone.

Attached is our accelerator deck and a short cohort timeline. Our procurement lead needs an outline of the qualification criteria and milestone gating so we can include it in the sponsor pack.

Key questions for you:
- Do you have precedent on conditional credit releases tied to milestones?
- Are there contractual or billing constraints we should plan for (SOW length, invoice cadence)?

Happy to hop on a quick call if that helps — Elena (cc’d) and our ops contact at LaunchLab will join.

Best,
Elena
Program Director, Founders Edge
Founders Edge
Attachments: FoundersEdge_Accelerator_Deck_2026-09-29.pdf (presentation)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@foundersedge.xyz>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Founders Edge accelerator — request for starter credits and milestone plan

Elena — thanks for the deck and the clear ask. Short answers first: we do precedent conditional releases, and we can structure billing as either a sponsored credit draw (recommended) or a short-term invoice depending on your procurement needs.

Proposed approach (high level):
- Conditional credits: release 50% up front, 25% after milestone 1 (integration & baseline eval), 25% after milestone 2 (demo day / production readiness).
- Trial extension: one-month cohort-level extension available for companies that meet the integration milestone; we can make this automatic if the cohort passes a basic token-usage smoke test.
- Contracting: a short MSA amendment + a sponsor addendum that describes the credit pool and milestone gates. We usually keep sponsor addenda to 12 months.

I’ve attached our credit terms draft for sponsor pools (redwood_credit_terms_v2.docx). Priyom — can you confirm whether a three-way sponsor invoice is needed or we can apply credits against the cohort owner? Marissa — can you flag any capacity constraints for mid-October cohorts?

If it’s helpful, I can put a conditional approval into the deal record pending a short intake form from each startup (company size, expected peak qps, PII risk level).

—
Kimberly Park
Programs Lead, Redwood Inference
kimmie@redwood.ai
Attachments: redwood_credit_terms_v2.docx (terms draft)

From: Elena Morales <elena@foundersedge.xyz>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: LaunchLab Partnerships <partnerships@launchlab.co>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 08:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Founders Edge accelerator — request for starter credits and milestone plan

Kimberly — this looks great, and the milestone split makes sense. A couple of clarifications from our procurement side:

1) We prefer a single sponsor invoice (Founders Edge) that Redwood applies credits against; could you confirm that workflow?
2) A handful of our startups will need a full 2-month trial extension for deeper model evals — is that outside your standard policy?

Attached is the cohort intake template filled with the first four companies; we can provide the rest by Oct 6. Procurement is on a tight cadence and asked whether we can get conditional approval before Oct 8.

Thanks — happy to take a 20-minute call to align on procurement and contract language if needed.

Best,
Elena
Attachments: FE_Cohort_Intake_Q1.xlsx (cohort intake)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 16:41:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Founders Edge — approve sponsor credit path (decision & next steps)

Team — putting the external thread here and proposing a decision we can communicate back to Founders Edge: approve a 150k token + 20k embedding sponsor pool with the following concessions:

- Release schedule: 75k tokens up front (50%), 37.5k tokens at milestone 1, 37.5k at milestone 2. Embeddings split the same way.
- Extension policy: offer a cohort-level automatic 1-month trial extension; for individual companies requesting 2 months, approve on a case-by-case basis (require product sign-off + a short tech checklist).
- Billing: we will generate a sponsor invoice to Founders Edge (credits applied to their invoice) — Priyom, please confirm accounting flow and whether we need a separate purchase order.
- Contracting: Marissa, can you prepare a short sponsor addendum and route for e-sign before Oct 8? If we approve the 2-month exceptions, we’ll include a clause for product review.

I recommend we tag this as a low-risk sponsor (cohort companies are early stage, low-PII) and expedite the HubSpot deal stage to "Sponsor Committed" to match procurement timing. If we agree, I’ll send the formal conditional approval to Elena this evening.

Thoughts?

—Kimberly
Programs Lead, Redwood Inference
